posts.title: Road closure on Tanner's Row, 19 to 21 October
posts.body_html:
Tanner's Row will be closed between the bakery and Pellow Street from Monday 19 October while the water board replaces a main.

  • Buses will stop on Ferrier Lane instead
  • Pedestrian access stays open

Questions go to the bulletin team.

posts.title: Found: blue scooter by the allotment gate
posts.body_html: A small blue scooter was left by the allotment gate on Thursday evening. It is now in the shed at number 14.
